title: Dashi & Brined Chicken Soba Noodle Soup
ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken thighs, brined lightly in salt water
4 cups Japanese dashi stock (kombu + bonito dashi)
1 tbsp Yondu umami seasoning or white miso paste
3 scallions (green onions), thinly sliced on a bias
instructions: Bring dashi stock to a gentle simmer. Poach the brined chicken thighs in the broth for 10–12 minutes, skimming any scum from the surface.
Season the hot dashi broth to taste with soy sauce, mirin, and Yondu (or whisk in miso off the heat). Slice the poached chicken.
Boil buckwheat soba noodles in a separate pot of unsalted water for 4–5 minutes, drain, and rinse briefly under cold water to remove excess starch before warming in the broth.
Divide soba noodles into bowls, ladle the steaming umami broth over top, and garnish with sliced chicken, scallions, and shichimi togarashi.
